project_tracker_diagnostic: Much-branched green shrublet with narrow willowlike leaves and masses of small discoid heads; common in disturbed sites and roadsides.

project_inclusion.learning_reason: Common or useful Central Texas fall/white composite for field learning.

morphology_keys.leaves: Alternate, narrow oblanceolate to linear-oblanceolate, often entire to shallowly toothed near the tip.
morphology_keys.heads: Small discoid heads; female plants especially showy in fruit from the white pappus.
morphology_keys.fruit: Cypselae with conspicuous white pappus in fruit.

photo_strategy.selection_logic: Prefer curated taxon photos plus multiple views from one Central Texas/Texas observation.
